abstract: Almost all cases with malignant transformation of a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary have been reported to be associated with squamous cell carcinoma. We describe a very rare case of mucinous cystadenocarcinoma with sarcoma-like mural nodules arising in an ovarian teratoma.
abstract_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化のほぼすべての症例は扁平上皮癌を伴うと報告されている。今回、卵巣奇形腫に生じた、肉腫様の壁在結節を伴う粘液性嚢胞腺癌の極めて稀な症例を報告する。
